scientific_integrity: Analytic proof under a precisely specified idealized Gaussian-time and Poisson-saturation display-allocation model; numerical checks support, not replace, the proof. Not empirical validation or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: One contiguous interval with uniform total-budget display; no claim for arbitrary intensity profiles, multiple blooming episodes or finite-season constraints.
Gaussian opportunity time and independent Poisson-saturation success are assumed rather than empirically fitted.
Historical originality is conditional on accessed sources; analogous coverage/scheduling theory may exist outside inspected literature.
title: Sharp cube-root bounds for resource-limited flowering windows
